text_block_list.text:
On this day, the horse girls were invited 
as guests to an event in a 
carrot-producing region that had long 
supported the academy.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Hi, I'm so glad to meet you all! Thank you 
everyone for coming! I'm Daring Heart!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
H-Hello! I'm Rhein Kraft from Tracen 
Academy!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, she's my best friend and rival, 
competing together aiming to become 
"Queen"!

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
Ooh~, what a passionate introduction! Now 
then, let's get right into the talk show—

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, everyone's so kind! I hope they 
take today's memories home and cherish 
them.

text_block_list.name: Gloomy Boy
text_block_list.text: ...Haaaah~...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, hey there, kid. You look somewhat 
bored, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Gloomy Boy
text_block_list.text:
'Cause... I didn't even wanna come, my 
parents just dragged me along... I wanted 
to play video games at home.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Tahaha... It's true we only did talking. 
Was our conversation a bit boring for you?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
...With just a single run, she stole 
everyone's hearts right away, didn't she?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
...OK! In that case, why don't I show you 
something hot that'll ignite a fire in 
your heart!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Hot... like a race? We don't have a 
racetrack here though...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: That depends on our idea. Let's see... hm?

Right then, an enormous 
monster-truck-class tiller was seen 
driving along the road outside.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: ...I got it! That's it!

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
Things have taken an unbelievable turn! An 
impromptu hot-blooded field-tilling 
showdown between an active horse girl and 
a power tiller!

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
Whoever tills more soil within the time 
limit wins! And now—battle start!

text_block_list.name: Tiller Owner
text_block_list.text: Hahaa! Engine start!

text_block_list.name: Industry Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Heh... There's no way she can beat that 
monster tiller. It's a beast that can till 
ten ridges in the blink of an eye, you 
know?

text_block_list.name: Gloomy Boy
text_block_list.text:
...There's no way she can win. Against an 
amazing machine like that—

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: ............ Is that really so?

text_block_list.name: Tiller Owner
text_block_list.text:
Hahaa! There's already a 3-ridge lead! Why 
don't you just give up!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
...Unfortunately for you, I'll pass. 
Giving up isn't in my nature. The stronger 
the opponent—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
—The higher the summit I aim for, —the 
hotter I burn!

text_block_list.name: Gloomy Boy
text_block_list.text:
What?! H-Her hands swinging the hoe— are 
so fast you can't even see them?!

text_block_list.name: Industry Commentator
text_block_list.text:
What's more, on unstable footing unlike a 
racetrack, she's precisely maneuvering the 
hoe with each swing and tilling the 
soil... What an incredible feat?!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
I-I get it! For Heart-san, who trains in 
the mountains regularly... unstable 
footing is practically her home turf!

text_block_list.name: Boy Who Was Gloomy
text_block_list.text: D-Do your best!! Heart big sis!!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
"Uooooohh!!!!" "Go for it—!! Show 'em the 
machine's full power—!!" "HEART!! HEART!!"

Daring Heart tilling the soil with 
tremendous momentum... And after a fierce 
back-and-forth battle against the power 
tiller—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
1.23 tan to 1.22 tan—whew. Looks like I 
fell just one step short.

text_block_list.name: Tiller Owner
text_block_list.text:
...I can't even think of this as a win. I 
pushed the machine way too hard... It 
won't move until I give it proper 
maintenance.

text_block_list.name: Boy Who Was Gloomy
text_block_list.text: A-Amazing... That was amazing!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
It really was a wonderful match! Not just 
this boy, but me and all the guests were 
totally engrossed.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. It was an unusual contest, but it 
seems we fired up everyone's hearts.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
However, in my next race I'll show you 
something even hotter. —Everyone, don't 
miss it!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
—Fufu. Captivating people simply by 
running there. I may not have caught up to 
Ramonu-san's presence yet, but.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Without fail—I will become the next 
"Queen" following after her.
